rule: Core evaluation ends after 36 calendar months
derivation_rationale: A bounded horizon permits a mandatory decision without waiting for a favorable regime; it is not calibrated to any realized result.

rule: One extension is permitted only after INCONCLUSIVE
derivation_rationale: A single fixed addition can improve information while preventing repeated optional stopping.

rule: No evaluation may extend beyond the original start plus one extension
derivation_rationale: The 36-month core plus one 12-month extension is a finite predeclared maximum.

rule: Minimum paired daily sessions for directional primary evidence
derivation_rationale: A minimum information count is required for a HAC estimate; it does not require a number of favorable trades or crossings.

rule: Cap for the predeclared Newey-West lag rule
derivation_rationale: The cap limits unstable long lags while the formula scales with the observed sample size.

rule: Two-sided confidence interval level
derivation_rationale: A conventional uncertainty display is fixed before observations and is not selected for a desired result.

rule: One-sided alpha when adequacy is met
derivation_rationale: The directional error rate is declared before the primary weekly series exists; no p-value is calculated now.

rule: Annualized HAC interval materially below this floor is economic FAIL
derivation_rationale: A two-percentage-point negative floor distinguishes harmful degradation from uncertainty around zero; it is a conservative design limit, not a historical quantile.

rule: p95 absolute observed slippage must not exceed
derivation_rationale: A conservative operational tolerance flags material deviation from the 5-bps model assumption without changing that assumption.

rule: p95 absolute strategy-versus-canonical tracking difference must not exceed
derivation_rationale: A predeclared half-percent tail tolerance catches systematic implementation drift.

rule: Signal-to-order latency must not exceed
derivation_rationale: Five minutes accommodates ordinary timestamped order creation while detecting a delayed decision boundary.

rule: Order-to-fill latency must not exceed
derivation_rationale: Fifteen minutes is an operational tolerance for the next-open paper record, not a performance target.

rule: A scheduled close acquired later than this is stale and incident-only
derivation_rationale: A fixed freshness boundary makes stale-data handling deterministic and fail-closed.

rule: Strategy MaxDD below this level is a severe-risk economic failure
derivation_rationale: A conservative severe-loss stop is set prospectively to protect capital-risk governance; it does not claim historical dominance.

rule: Strategy drawdown difference versus QQQ below this level is a hard risk failure
derivation_rationale: Ten percentage points is a predeclared material-deterioration limit that keeps QQQ comparison visible.

rule: Annual turnover using contemporaneous pretrade equity must not exceed
derivation_rationale: Six times capital is a prospective implementation-burden ceiling and is not calibrated to an observed outcome.

rule: Absolute NAV reconciliation difference must be at most
derivation_rationale: One cent is a serialization and rounding tolerance for ledger reconciliation, not an economic allowance.

rule: Absolute tax-ledger reconciliation difference must be at most
derivation_rationale: One cent catches ledger drift while allowing deterministic cent rounding.

rule: Simplified immediate realized-tax rate remains
derivation_rationale: This is carried unchanged from Research v1.0 and is not a prospective tuning parameter.

rule: Commission assumption remains
derivation_rationale: The accepted zero-commission convention is preserved for path comparability.

rule: Canonical simulated slippage assumption remains
derivation_rationale: The accepted five-basis-point model input is immutable; observed slippage is reported separately.
